correctness.rationale: The overlap graph has one labeled edge per reversal class, signed types at nonpalindromic endpoint incidences; any covering word induces a compatible alternating-type edge walk. The mandatory graph has odd counts 8,14,16,30 for n=6..9, and the extra alternating trails must meet the deficient types except for two free endpoints. Thus a shortest-type-path perfect-matching relaxation lower-bounds additional traversals. All 4 finite certificates give integer doubled vertex potentials satisfying each pair and terminal dual inequality with total objective precisely 2*(7,14,19,38). I independently reconstructed the signed graphs and BFS transitions, verified all pair inequalities and the explicit binary upper words contain all reversal classes. This is exhaustive finite certification of exactly four n, conditional on the mathematical trail reduction, not a speculative extrapolation.
